newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends mixed, cocoa weaker, sugar dull.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends mixed, cocoa weaker, sugar dull.

text.p: COFFEE - Mixed. Jan ends $5 higher at $1,447 after a $23 range after brief NY rally on green stocks rise met producer selling.
COCOA - Slips further towards recent lows on origin, arbitrage selling. Switches, AAs dominate. March ends 11 down at 914 stg.
SUGAR - Trapped in ranges, light volume as commission buyers meet trade sellers. March up 60 cents at $302.80 at 1713 GMT.
